market_outlook.short_term: Bearish. ASX under pressure from oil-driven rate-hike repricing, iron ore weakness, and recession fears. Banks and property lead declines. Gold and energy producers provide relative strength. Expect ^AXJO volatility above 2% daily.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautiously constructive if oil normalises and RBA pivots. Structural themes: AI infrastructure demand, WA gold pipeline, copper supercycle. But iron ore structural decline and China trade risk cap upside. 6-12 month path likely range-bound with sector rotation.
